Centreon QA · CI · Xray / Jira

Test-result pipeline — architecture & flows

The CI pipeline as staged jobs, the reusable test job that talks to Xray, and the two outcome states a Test Execution ends in. Runs on nightly / testing only — never on PRs.

Xray-related job / phase standard CI job passed → Closed failed / aborted → Execution failed run-level guard

QA / Xray view. Build, lint, package and deliver stages are omitted. xray-prepare-test-plan feeds the plan key to the two test jobs, which run once the test image (dockerize, built upstream) is ready. The Xray work happens inside each test job — zoomed in §2.

3

Outcome routing

Results come from the import; the Test Execution status is set by the enrich.

Run outcomeTransitions followedFinal status
All tests PASSEDReady to execute → Start execution → End execution → CloseClosed
Any test FAILED or ABORTEDReady to execute → Start execution → Execution to failedExecution failed

One Test Execution per run (import passes testPlanKey, not testExecKey); the Test Plan aggregates the latest result per test.

Run & Test Execution statuses, and how Test Plans are named.

Test run status (per test, in an execution)

StatusCoverageFinalMeaningIn this flow
PASSEDOKyesAll assertions passedfrom import
FAILEDNOKyesAn assertion failedfrom import
ABORTEDNOTRUNyesStarted but never finishedset by enrich
BLOCKEDNOKnoRun blocked by a dependencymanual
EXECUTINGNOTRUNnoIn progress / no result yettransient → enrich aborts it
TO DONOTRUNnoNot starteddefault before run

Test Execution status (Jira workflow)

StatusCategorySet byRole in the flow
Open RequestTo DoinitialCreated here by the import
Ready to executeTo DoenrichReached via Ready to execute
In executionIn ProgressenrichReached via Start execution
Execution completedIn ProgressenrichPass path · via End execution
ClosedDoneenrichAll passed · via Close
Execution failedIn ProgressenrichAny FAILED / ABORTED · via Execution to failed
Blocked · Waiting delivery / decision / fixIn ProgressmanualTrap states — never auto-followed
ReopenedTo DomanualRe-open after Closed

Two axes. Run status (top) is a result set by the import (or aborted by the enrich); Test Execution status (bottom) is the Jira workflow the enrich walks to Closed / Execution failed.
